purpose: Declarative framework enrichment rules for turning verified Quarkus and Spring Boot metadata into separate synthetic call facts.

requires: one target after framework metadata and profile filtering
source, bytecode, or framework metadata that identifies the edge
no open-world or unmodeled runtime step
evidence identifies the candidate set but not one runtime target
missing framework metadata, open-world behavior, or unconstrained dynamic target

certaintyPolicy.promotionGuard: Never promote possible or unresolved framework/dynamic behavior to definite without new unique evidence in the selected AnalysisContext.

edgeTypes.description: A framework-owned external event or dispatcher invokes an application method.
A framework injection point binds to a bean candidate or bean constructor.
A generated framework proxy, interceptor, or decorator dispatches to an application method.
A framework lifecycle owner invokes a bean, factory, runner, or callback method.
Framework metadata binds an abstraction to generated application or framework implementation code.

resolutionRules.when: One effective @Path plus HTTP method maps to one application method in the selected profile.
resolutionRules.fallback: possible for bounded route candidates; unresolved when route metadata or profile context is missing.

resolutionRules.when: One eligible bean remains after type, qualifier, alternative, and profile filtering.
resolutionRules.fallback: possible for a bounded source-visible candidate when Arc metadata is not captured; unresolved when type, qualifier, profile, or open-world dependency context is missing.

resolutionRules.when: The bean type is known but the generated proxy/interceptor implementation is not captured.
resolutionRules.fallback: unresolved when the proxy target type is not bounded.

resolutionRules.when: The generated source root is selected and the generated symbol resolves uniquely.
resolutionRules.fallback: possible for a bounded generated implementation without source; unresolved when generation metadata is absent.

abstentions.trigger: Class.forName, Method.invoke, or equivalent target is not constrained by metadata.
abstentions.reason: A string or reflective call does not identify a unique method.

abstentions.trigger: Proxy target interfaces or handler bindings are not bounded by source/configuration evidence.
abstentions.reason: Generated proxy identity cannot be inferred from Proxy usage alone.

resolutionRules.when: One effective @RequestMapping plus HTTP method maps to one controller method in the selected context.
resolutionRules.fallback: possible for bounded route candidates; unresolved when effective properties or route metadata is missing.

resolutionRules.when: One component or @Bean candidate remains after profile, condition, qualifier, and primary filtering.
resolutionRules.fallback: possible for a bounded source-visible candidate when the bean registry is not captured; unresolved when profiles, conditions, qualifiers, or the effective ApplicationContext are missing.

resolutionRules.when: An advisor identifies a bounded target method but generated proxy/interceptor order is not captured.
resolutionRules.fallback: unresolved when advisor or target metadata is missing.

resolutionRules.when: A repository interface and Spring Data factory contract identify a bounded generated implementation.
resolutionRules.fallback: unresolved when repository factory or effective context metadata is missing.

resolutionRules.when: A @Bean method or CommandLineRunner implementation is selected in the effective application context.
resolutionRules.fallback: unresolved when conditional configuration or startup ordering is not known.

abstentions.trigger: Profiles, conditions, external properties, or component-scan boundaries are missing.
abstentions.reason: Source annotations alone do not prove that a bean is instantiated in the selected context.

abstentions.trigger: Reflection or dynamically selected proxy target is not constrained by Spring metadata.
abstentions.reason: Framework ownership does not make an open-world target unique.
